answer_1.quote: In this work, we transfer a denoising autoencoder pre-trained on the sequence-to-sequence task to the paraphrase generation task and then use it to generate paraphrases.

answer_2.quote: We use the bi-gram diversity (dist-2) metric as proposed by , which computes the number of distinct 2-grams divided by the total amount of tokens. We also report the average similarity (denoted use) within each sentence set, using the Universal Sentence Encoder as an independent sentence encoder.
